stem: Based on the graph and your knowledge of U.S. history, how did changes in the birth rate affect the U.S. economy in the 1950s?

options.label: A
options.text: Prosperity increased as a result of the expanded housing values in rural and urban areas.

options.label: B
options.text: Prosperity decreased because of the number of children who were unable to access public education.

options.label: C
options.text: Prosperity increased as a result of a higher demand for consumer products for the emerging middle class.

options.label: D
options.text: Prosperity decreased because of the number of people relying on social welfare programs in rural and urban areas.

visual_elements: U.S. Birth Rate, 1940–1960 bar graph with birth rates per 1,000 people for 1940, 1945, 1950, 1955, and 1960
